### Morning and Evening, Set Your Prayers Before the Lord
Author: Shirlee Abbott
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-12-2024.html
Passage: Psalm 141:2
Points:
- Picturing prayer as fragrant smoke illustrates how our words please God.
- Forgetting to begin and end each day in prayer leaves life feeling incomplete.
- The tabernacle priesthood maintained a continual morning and evening offering of incense.
- Every moment of the day offers an opportunity to bring honest thoughts to God.
- Personal prayers join a historic and global chorus of believers praising the Lord.

### One Mouth, Two Ears
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-august-29-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 141:3
Points:
- People should listen carefully before speaking rather than jumping to conclusions.
- Our spoken words serve as a diagnostic indicator of our true inner character.
- Though David faced giants and wild animals, he knew the tongue was dangerous.
- Believers must not retaliate with evil words when spoken against by others.
- Guarding the mouth requires divine help because human strength is not enough.
